family: A 4x4 Hermitian phase-covariant witness has arbitrary Hermitian correlated block H on span{|ii>} and real diagonal coefficients d_ij on each |ij>, i!=j; these are precisely the matrices invariant under every local diagonal-phase action U tensor conjugate(U). For a 2-block-positive witness d_ij>=0. Write q_ij=sqrt(d_ij*d_ji).
unconditional_low_graph_restriction: The graph on four indices with edges q_ij<|H_ij| must be connected for a 2-block-positive W to be indecomposable. If it is disconnected, for every cross-component pair q_ij>=|H_ij| choose a PSD 2x2 block on (|ij>,|ji>) with offdiagonal H_ij and diagonal (|H_ij|/q_ij)*d_ij,(|H_ij|/q_ij)*d_ji; use zero when q_ij=0. Its partial transpose cancels the cross-component correlated entry, and leaves a nonnegative diagonal remainder. Each remaining component restriction is 2-block positive in local dimension at most 3, hence decomposable by the established Yang-Leung-Tang theorem https://arxiv.org/abs/1603.03534. This part is independent of the new Z-correlated candidate.
conditional_cycle_restriction: Conditional on the UNREVIEWED Z-correlated theorem frontier-20261028-Z-correlated-witness-general-v1.json SHA256 8b58f10c7ede1d3a1d471c6d0f132579b4c8f5d90f093b2275048d71c1664a16, an indecomposable 2-block-positive W must also have a frustrated phase cycle in the graph of nonzero H_ij. Indeed, a local diagonal phase conjugation makes every nonzero H_ij real nonpositive if and only if the product of -H_ij/|H_ij| around every oriented cycle is 1; choose a root phase and propagate along a spanning forest, and the cycle equalities guarantee consistency. If all cycles are balanced, the resulting witness is in the Z-correlated family and is decomposable. Consequently a forest of nonzero H_ij is automatically excluded. Frustration may occur even for real H: a triangle whose edge product is positive is an example; do not infer a genuinely complex witness is necessary.
limits: These are necessary conditions on this special phase-covariant witness family, not sufficient conditions for 2-block positivity or indecomposability. No candidate PPT/SN3 state or globally valid negative witness is constructed. The cycle exclusion inherits the unreviewed status of its prerequisite; no novelty or formal review claim.
